# STDN Technologies

> STDN Technologies (stdn.in) builds intelligent software for Indian businesses: its own products and custom software. Based in Jind, Haryana. Udyam-registered MSME (UDYAM-HR-08-0059791).

## Products
- [MedDesk](https://www.stdn.in/meddesk): pharmacy ERP for Windows. Billing, batch-wise stock and expiry, purchases and returns, GST reports, backups, and AI that reads supplier bills from a photo. Now launching.
- [School ERP](https://www.stdn.in/school-erp): web app for school fees and students, with monthly ledgers, late fees, Razorpay payments, receipts, WhatsApp/email reminders and a parent portal.
- [Hotel ERP](https://www.stdn.in/hotel-erp): Windows app for hotels with a restaurant. Room board, check-in, table orders with KOT, thermal printing and GST billing. Live.

## Custom software
- [Custom software](https://www.stdn.in/services): websites, web apps, mobile apps and AI systems (website chatbots, WhatsApp bots, document reading, automation).
